messages:
Maya: Heads-up — t-minus ~45m for feat/kv-cache rollout to prod (22:00 UTC). I'm the deploy owner. Plan: canary 5% for 15m -> full. Need a quick rollback/runbook sanity pass.
Ronan: I'm oncall for this window, I can own the smoke pass after canary. What are our hard rollback triggers?
Sylvia: From the board: 1) error rate jump >0.8% sustained for 3m, 2) p95 latency +50% vs baseline for 5m, 3) request-level tokenization errors >0.1% or any crash loop in runtime pods.
Maya: Rollback actions (short form) in runbook — keeping minimal for the handoff:
```
1) Flip feature flag: ff-admin set feat_kv_cache=false (Ken on standby)
2) Reroute traffic: routing-service promote model-v1 (traffic switch)
3) Scale down new replica set: k scale rs/kv-cache-2026 --replicas=0 -n inference
4) If image revert needed: deployctl rollback service/inference --to=sha@model-v1
5) Postmortem marker: tag release as revert-<ts> and open quick incident folder
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: feat/kv-cache -> prod @ 22:00 UTC. Canary target: 5% for 15m. Notified: @Ronan, @Ken.
Ken: I'll be ready to flip the flag. Slack ping me with "go/no-go" and I'll run the ff-admin toggle. Also have keys to the infra console if we need manual reroute.
Ronan: I'll watch SLO dashboard, traces, and tokenization logs. My quick checks after canary start: errors.overall, p95 latency by route, slow_kv logs > 0.5% buckets, and queue depth on worker-2.
Maya: Smoke checklist (copying minimal checklist — will run it live):
```
- sanity: /health (200) x5
- sample generation: prompt set A -> validate outputs (no OOMs)
- KV hitrate sanity: /metrics kv.hitrate (expect > 80% after warm)
- end-to-end latency: sample bulk (p50,p95) vs baseline
- fraction of reroutes: check routing logs for unexpected 502s
```
Sylvia: Adding one operational note: if p95 spikes but error rate is flat, hold and investigate for 10m — don't immediately flip unless errors or tokenization failures.
Maya: Link to full runbook + console: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/rollout/2755012345
Ken: acked. I'll be online at deploy +20m and listening.
Ronan: ack — I'll post a short status at canary+5m and canary+15m.
Maya: Thanks — if anyone sees anything abnormal before deploy ping in this thread. Go/no-go here when you have checks. :thumbsup:
Ken: go for me unless Ronan calls an abort.
Ronan: holding for canary+5m signal, will post go/no-go then.
Maya: great, standing by.
